answer: A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, and therefore paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. Cosignatures are collected in trellis, verified in bridge, and mirror names every witness. Each submission needs cosignature from 3 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 49 submissions per epoch. A 75 account operation therefore ties up 20 million dollars of idle capital. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
